anon_desc.plain_fetch: Fetch a URL with a plain HTTP GET and return the main text as Markdown. Does not run JavaScript. PDFs are converted to text.
anon_desc.firecrawl_scrape: Fetch a URL and return the page as Markdown. Runs JavaScript before extracting. PDFs are converted to text.
anon_desc.tinyfish_fetch: Fetch a URL and return the page as Markdown. Runs JavaScript before extracting.
anon_desc.tinyfish_agent: Give a browser agent a start URL and a goal in plain language. It can click, scroll, paginate and fill forms (up to 5 steps), then returns what it found.
